accidentalsDesc: Sharps, flats or naturals outside the key signature may appear
accidentalsProbabilityDesc: Each note gains a sharp, flat or natural with this probability.
clefDescription: Choose which staff the exercises use — it decides how you read the score.
durationsNaturalizeDesc: Draws selected durations with weighted ratios — eighth 37%, sixteenth 26%, quarter 20%, others share 17% — instead of equal odds. Dots multiply on top of the duration's ratio.
durationsSelected: {count} durations selected — drawn at random during practice.
melodyChordDiatonicHint: Uses the scale-degree triads and seventh chords of the chosen key (triads C, Dm, Em, F, G, Am, Bdim and sevenths Cmaj7, Dm7, Em7, Fmaj7, G7, Am7, Bm7b5 in C major); qualities follow the key and cannot be chosen — the degree, inversion and octave are drawn at random.
melodyChordHint: Each chord is played as one complete run: the root is a random scale tone of the chosen key, the type and inversion are drawn at random, and the whole chord stays in range; a chord continues across measures and rests.
melodyChordNoAccidentals: No random accidentals in broken-chord mode.
melodyChordRangeTooNarrow: The current range is too narrow for the selected chords — widen the range first.
melodyChordSizesRequired: Select at least one chord structure.
melodyChordTypesRequired: Select at least one chord type.
melodyDescription: Choose how the melody moves: fully random, by chosen intervals, or as continuous broken chords.
melodyIntervalNoAccidentals: No accidentals appear in interval mode.
melodyIntervalsHint: Each note moves from the previous one by a chosen interval, up or down at random; the key signature still applies.
melodyRangeTooNarrow: The current range is too narrow for the selected intervals — widen the range first.
practiceDescription: Set the size of each exercise.
rangeDescription: Set the lowest and highest notes that can appear.
rangeKeyboardAria: Piano keyboard diagram; the current exercise range is {from} to {to}
rhythmDescription: Control the rhythmic density of the exercises.
rhythmDotsProbabilityDesc: Each ticked duration turns dotted with this probability.
rhythmRestsDesc: Rests will appear — keep counting the beat
rhythmRestsProbabilityDesc: Each beat position becomes a rest instead of a note with this probability.
rhythmTripletsDesc: Three equal notes per beat — mind the transitions
rhythmTripletsProbabilityDesc: Each note is rewritten as one note of a triplet with this probability.
summaryFootnote: Prototype: the practice page judges your playing via MIDI input; exercises themselves are still randomly generated.
summaryPracticeTip: Reminder: generated exercises are no substitute for real sheet music — supplement your practice with real pieces that match your level.
